journeys.goal: Manage my existing models and use reviewed guidance in a new Generate request.

new_user.default_route: Choose Manage local models, review the empty or registered model list, then Cancel to return.
new_user.overload_guard: Reuse canonical Models command groups; no automatic scan, acquisition or execution.
new_user.ease_check: Know which existing model file or folder to inspect, and that opening the workspace changes no model.

advanced_user.entry: Choose the existing Planning, Storage or Provider Evidence group.
advanced_user.customization: Use canonical model notes, storage previews or reviewed guidance.
advanced_user.continuity: Existing model transactions and original Generate drafts are preserved.

consistency.reference: Original all-in-one Setup > Local Generation (the same SwarmRuntimeWidget)
shared_patterns: A visible task list selects one pane.
The contextual return stays outside the selected task.
departures: Connection and runtime status stay above the task list because they apply to every task; generator actions retain their existing separate review dialogs.

steps.expected: Canonical local Models workspace opens over Manager model registry.
Return to Applications; idle entry has not created or changed model files.

completion.visible: Applications returns with Manage local models available.
completion.authority: Same scoped registry as Generate and Training; original model transactions and physical worker drain.

recovery.trigger: Busy Generate or stale reviewed model guidance.
recovery.expected: Return to Models keeps the original recommendation for review; no existing draft is overwritten.

automation.notes: The declared visible route is entry and Close only. Supplemental direct handoff tests do not qualify model registration, storage, full guidance, native startup or installed package journeys.

journeys.goal: Register an existing local model, keep my notes and use reviewed guidance in a saved new image request.

new_user.default_route: Choose Manage local models, review the empty or registered model list, then Cancel to return.
new_user.overload_guard: Reuse canonical Models command groups; no automatic scan, acquisition or execution.
new_user.ease_check: Know which existing model file or folder to inspect, and that opening the workspace changes no model.

departures: Connection and runtime status stay above the task list because they apply to every task; generator actions retain their existing separate review dialogs.

steps.action: Open Manage local models, Inspect File and choose the existing synthetic safe-tensor file.
steps.expected: Metadata-only inspection shows the exact file identity; Register Model requires declared type and family.

steps.action: Register, save model notes, Close Models and reopen the saved model.
steps.expected: Same file identity and saved notes are retained; original file bytes are unchanged.

steps.action: Choose Planning and Recommend for Image Generation; review and accept the recommendation.
steps.expected: Continue Reviewed Setup in Generate opens only a new request with the exact registered model identity.

steps.action: Save Draft As through the real chooser.
steps.expected: Saved plan readback has the chosen model, goal and guidance provenance; no model executed.

completion.visible: New Generate draft is visibly saved.
completion.authority: Registry notes and new generation plan are read back independently; exact source model is preserved.

recovery.trigger: Busy Generate or stale reviewed model guidance.
recovery.expected: Return to Models keeps the original recommendation for review; no existing draft is overwritten.

automation.notes: Connected source-visible registration/notes/reopen/recommendation/new-draft/save route passed with real Qt choosers. Captures and bounded source-component review retained locally. Manifest stays partial for broader/native/recovery qualification; synthetic hardware and tensor file do not prove execution.
